PostgreSQL & SQLAlchemy Relational Database Schema

Included in backend/schema.sql and backend/app/models.py

CREATE TABLE users (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  hashed_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  role VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, -- 5 RBAC Roles
  institution VARCHAR(255),
  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE patients (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  patient_code VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- De-identified e.g. PT-2026-101
  age INTEGER CHECK (age BETWEEN 0 AND 120),
  gender VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  fitzpatrick_skin_type VARCHAR(16),
  medical_history TEXT,
  known_allergies TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE cases (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  case_code VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  patient_id INTEGER REFERENCES patients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  body_location VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  image_source VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  analysis_status VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'PREPROCESSED_READY',
  model_version VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'M1-Preproc-v1.0',
  clinical_notes TEXT,
  capture_date TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE case_images (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  image_code VARCHAR(64) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  case_id INTEGER REFERENCES cases(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  width_px INT, height_px INT, file_size_kb FLOAT,
  blur_score FLOAT, brightness_score FLOAT, contrast_score FLOAT,
  lesion_visibility_score FLOAT,
  quality_status VARCHAR(32) CHECK (quality_status IN ('Good Quality','Acceptable Quality','Poor Quality')),
  raw_storage_path TEXT, preprocessed_storage_path TEXT
);

How to Run & Host DermAI Milestone 1

You have been provided both this self-contained interactive web application (DermAI_Milestone1_Platform.html) and the complete full-stack repository ZIP (DermAI_Milestone1_FullStack_Repo.zip).

Option 1: Instant Static Hosting (Zero Config)

Drop DermAI_Milestone1_Platform.html (renamed to index.html) onto GitHub Pages, Netlify Drop, Vercel, or AWS S3. Every Milestone 1 module (Camera/Upload, Quality Check, 4-stage OpenCV-equivalent Preprocessing, Case Management, EDA Charts, and RBAC) works in the browser.

Option 2: Full-Stack Docker Compose (FastAPI + React + PostgreSQL)
unzip DermAI_Milestone1_FullStack_Repo.zip
cd dermai_milestone1_repo
docker compose up --build
# Frontend: http://localhost:5173 | FastAPI Swagger Docs: http://localhost:8000/docs
